clips.title: The story
paras: Nature spirits and kaldorei gather at the Grove of the Ancients, beside old temple ruins in southeastern Darkshore. Onu, an Ancient of Lore, watches over this sacred sanctuary near the Wildbend River.

In southeastern Darkshore, old temple stones surround the Grove of the Ancients. The Wildbend River runs through its heart, a quiet refuge amid a coastline troubled by corruption and restless wildlife. Nature spirits and kaldorei gather here as the Circle of Ancients, tending to the forest’s balance.

Onu, a towering Ancient of Lore, watches the land’s changing fortunes and offers wisdom to travelers. Wandering merchants and slumbering druids rest beneath the boughs. Territorial furbolg camps lie to the southeast, and Alliance sentinels and druids watch the southern reaches of Darkshore from this frontier outpost.
